summary: Fix two reported bugs. (1) Figure questions always sent the current page because the client's page-text cache was only populated on the extraction path (it returned early when the server already had the text), and the local scoring let body references out-score captions. Figure location is now decided by the server from the cached full text with caption-first matching; the client renders the given page. (2) The hover preview sometimes did nothing because renderCards() rebuilt the DOM while hoverKey stayed stale, so the early-return skipped the timer; re-rendering now clears hover state.
scope_note: Covers the diff since commit 3a21eaf. Service/endpoint + client UI; verification used cached text only (no model calls).

budget_impact.rationale: Retrieval and UI logic only; no model call, no operation or ceiling change.
budget_impact.before: Wrong page sent for figure questions; hover preview intermittently dead.
budget_impact.after: Caption-first server resolution (27 real caption pages, 0 mismatches) and hover state reset on re-render.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting
